hero.titleHtml: Chapter Two: Interference, Polarization, Diffraction, and Scattering Wave Phenomena of Light
hero.lead: From the colors of a soap bubble to the blue of the sky and the red of sunset: in this chapter we study the wave phenomena of light — interference and coherence, Young's experiment, thin-film interference, diffraction, polarization, and the scattering of light.

objectivesLead: After completing this chapter, the student will be able to:
objectives: Know the concept of interference, coherence, and the conditions for interference in thin films.
Understand Young's experiment for the formation of interference fringes with incident light.
Know the concept of diffraction and grasp some phenomena related to it.
Know the concept of polarization and how to distinguish between ordinary light and polarized light.
Know the concept of the scattering phenomenon in light.
